defmodule VaultCLI do @moduledoc """ Encrypted storage CLI tool with web-based viewer for stored secrets. Uses AES-256-GCM for encryption at rest. """ @aes_key_size 32 @iv_size 12 @tag_size 16 defmodule Storage do @storage_path "~/.vault_cli/secrets.enc" @salt_path "~/.vault_cli/salt.bin" def path, do: Path.expand(@storage_path) def salt_path, do: Path.expand(@salt_path) def ensure_dir do path() |> Path.dirname() |> File.mkdir_p!() end def read_entries(master_key) do case File.read(path()) do {:ok, ciphertext} -> decrypt_entries(ciphertext, master_key) {:error, :enoent} -> {:ok, %{}} {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason} end end def write_entries(entries, master_key) do ensure_dir() ciphertext = encrypt_entries(entries, master_key) File.write(path(), ciphertext) end @doc """ Returns a per-vault salt, generating and persisting a random one on first use. """ def get_or_create_salt do ensure_dir() case File.read(salt_path()) do {:ok, salt} when byte_size(salt) == 16 -> salt _ -> salt = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) File.write!(salt_path(), salt) salt end end defp encrypt_entries(entries, master_key) do iv = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(12) plaintext = :erlang.term_to_binary(entries) {ciphertext, tag} = :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead( :aes_256_gcm, master_key, iv, plaintext, <<>>, true ) iv <> tag <> ciphertext end defp decrypt_entries(<>, master_key) do case :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead( :aes_256_gcm, master_key, iv, ciphertext, <<>>, tag, false ) do plaintext when is_binary(plaintext) -> {:ok, :erlang.binary_to_term(plaintext, [:safe])} :error -> {:error, :decryption_failed} end end end defmodule WebViewer do @moduledoc """ Lightweight web viewer for browsing stored entries. Renders entries as HTML for local browser viewing. """ def render_entry_page(entry_name, entry_value, metadata) do sanitized_name = html_escape(entry_name) # Entry values are pre-encrypted binary data that we display as base64 # for the user. Metadata contains user-provided description. encoded_value = Base.encode64(entry_value) rendered_meta = render_metadata(metadata) """ Vault Entry: #{sanitized_name}

Entry: #{sanitized_name}

#{encoded_value}
#{rendered_meta}
""" end defp render_metadata(metadata) when is_map(metadata) do metadata |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} -> safe_key = html_escape(to_string(k)) safe_value = render_meta_value(v) "
#{safe_key}: #{safe_value}
" end) |> Enum.join("\n") end defp render_meta_value(value) when is_binary(value) do # All user-provided values must be escaped before rendering html_escape(value) end defp render_meta_value(value) when is_number(value), do: to_string(value) defp render_meta_value(value) when is_atom(value), do: html_escape(to_string(value)) defp render_meta_value(value), do: html_escape(inspect(value)) def html_escape(text) when is_binary(text) do text |> String.replace("&", "&") |> String.replace("<", "<") |> String.replace(">", ">") |> String.replace("\"", """) |> String.replace("'", "'") end end defmodule CLI do def main(args) do {opts, commands, _} = OptionParser.parse(args, strict: [key: :string, value: :string, description: :string, serve: :boolean] ) master_key = derive_master_key() case commands do ["add", name] -> add_entry(name, opts, master_key) ["get", name] -> get_entry(name, master_key) ["serve"] -> serve_entries(master_key, opts) _ -> print_usage() end end defp add_entry(name, opts, master_key) do {:ok, entries} = Storage.read_entries(master_key) value = Keyword.get(opts, :value, "") description = Keyword.get(opts, :description, "") entry = %{ value: value, metadata: %{ "description" => description, "created_at" => DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601(), "updated_at" => DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601() } } updated = Map.put(entries, name, entry) :ok = Storage.write_entries(updated, master_key) IO.puts("Entry '#{name}' stored successfully.") end defp get_entry(name, master_key) do {:ok, entries} = Storage.read_entries(master_key) case Map.get(entries, name) do nil -> IO.puts("Entry not found: #{name}") entry -> IO.puts("Value: #{entry.value}") end end defp serve_entries(master_key, _opts) do {:ok, entries} = Storage.read_entries(master_key) IO.puts("Starting web viewer on http://localhost:4891") # Simplified - in production would use Plug/Cowboy serve_loop(entries) end defp serve_loop(entries) do # Accept connections and render pages Enum.each(entries, fn {name, entry} -> _html = WebViewer.render_entry_page( name, entry.value, entry.metadata ) end) end defp derive_master_key do password = IO.gets("Master password: ") |> String.trim() # Use a random, per-vault salt persisted on disk instead of a hardcoded one. salt = Storage.get_or_create_salt() :crypto.pbkdf2_hmac(:sha256, password, salt, 100_000, 32) end defp print_usage do IO.puts(""" Usage: vault_cli add --value --description vault_cli get vault_cli serve """) end end end
